mentions.name: CVD diamond growth system
mentions.description: This is a DIY chemical vapor deposition (CVD) system for growing arbitrarily large single crystal optical quality diamonds, integrating microwave power sources, vacuum and gas supply systems, and other subsystems under LabView control, with ChatGPT and Claude used to guide the coding and integration work.
